gen.title: How flood probability is estimated and why storms and floods differ
gen.orderNote: Follows page order from data collection through probability to storm versus flood factors

steps.label: Gather historical rainfall and stage records
steps.quote: according to historical data about rainfall and stream stage, the probability of Soandso River reaching a stage of 20 feet is once in 100 years.
steps.orderHint: Start with what long records tell us

steps.label: Define recurrence interval by exceedance chance
steps.quote: The recurrence interval is based on the probability that the given event will be equaled or exceeded in any given year.

steps.label: Use sufficient years of record
steps.quote: Ten or more years of data are required to perform a frequency analysis for the determination of recurrence intervals.
steps.orderHint: Note how much data is needed

steps.label: Account for soil saturation before storm
steps.quote: Soil saturation before the storm: Existing conditions prior to the storm can influence the amount of stormwater runoff into the stream system.
